## What this changes

One paragraph. What is different after this lands.

## Why

The problem, not the solution. Link the issue, the decision record, or the
evidence that made this necessary. If there is none, say so: exploratory work is
welcome, and naming it as exploratory is enough.

## How it was verified

The commands you ran and their actual result. Not a claim that it works, the
output that shows it. If a check fails and you know why, say that instead of
leaving it out.

## Risk and reversibility

What breaks if this is wrong, and how it gets undone.

## Checklist

- [ ] The documented gate passes, from a clean checkout.
- [ ] No unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by a test that fails without this change.
- [ ] I understand what I am submitting, including anything generated.
